fact: On 30 January 2025 Burkina Faso launched Faso Arzeka, the single national digital platform for payments to central government, local authorities and public bodies, interconnected with bank cards, mobile money and bank transfer.
title: Plateforme numérique « Faso Arzeka » : le Président du CSC à la cérémonie de lancement
publisher: Conseil supérieur de la communication (CSC), Burkina Faso
